notes: City of Arlington, TX (Tarrant County), within city limits. Built by data/jurisidictions/run_arlington.py from one automated source: the City of Fort Worth's public copy of the Tarrant Appraisal District (TAD) roll (Parcels_Public_Vview), refreshed nightly from TAD. Values are TAD's 2026 appraisal (TAX_YEAR 2026 asserted). Clipped to the City of Arlington Municipal Boundary (centroid within); TAD's own taxing-unit code agrees on all but 62 / 31 parcels.

Exempt land is dropped. TAD almost never uses state class X (10 parcels), and its EXEMPTION_CODE is YES for any exemption including homesteads, so the exemption signal is $0 City of Arlington taxable value on an appraised non-residential parcel (763 of 768 city-owned parcels), plus class X and named public owners. Homes with $0 taxable (100% disabled-veteran homesteads, 1,677) stay in as private land.

Stacked records are summed onto their footprint: condo units mapped onto the whole complex polygon (The Cloisters: 491 units on 27.6 acres), undivided-interest owners each carrying a share, and lots split into accounts at school/TIF boundaries (1,061 footprints, 4,154 records). Condo developments drawn as unit outlines, and footprint-lot townhome developments (Inniswood, Main 7, South Center Street), are merged onto their land (1,204 units, 33 developments): their own common-area parcel when TAD has one (Texas Tax Code §23.18 values it at a nominal $1 because its value is in the units; 22 developments), else the unit hull grown into adjacent unparcelled ground, never into another parcel or road right-of-way (11; e.g. S Arlington Prof Bldg: 5 units, $296k land on 1.35 ac = $5.03/sqft). The other 177 nominal common areas (196 ac) are dropped like exempt land.

Land size: TAD's LAND_ACRE is used when within 25% of the polygon area, else the polygon area (on ~6.7k parcels LAND_ACRE holds square feet, a tiny fraction or a partial area). 10 sub-500 sqft remnants hidden.

Singularity sweep (land $/sqft >= 4x the 300 m neighbourhood and in the city's top 10%): 130 of 103,270 parcels, all genuine appraiser values on real footprints (N Collins St commercial frontage, small fee-simple lots, new infill lots, condo complexes on their plat polygons) except Magnolia Medical Condominiums (4.3x; its grounds may be an off-roll polygon, so the fill stays conservative). The review list is written to arlington-tx-singularities.csv on every run.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 277 lots, 265.5 acres, $71.2M est. land value. OSM has 598 parking polygons (729 acres) inside the city; the rest sit on exempt land (stadium complexes, UT Arlington, schools, churches) and are excluded by design. apply_parking_category.py tagged 8 parcels 'Parking Lot'.
